notes.title: Phantaruk Update 1.4.1
notes.content:
[b]Hello horror lovers![/b]

Phantaruk has just launched this week and we are working on some minor issues reported by the community. Update 1.4.1 fixes a lot of things and brings even more updates to the game.

Some of the most important changes are:

-added German language version
-improved Phantaruk behavior
-fixed issue with Phantaruk not showing on some levels
-fixed gamma settings issue while using gamepad
-updated the default gamepad controls
-updated the amount of syringes on every level
-fixed minor sound issues

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25706844/e40ab1b0007c9ef0360b10dd46e2304e5e645b10.jpg[/img]

Please take a look at the full list of updates, changes and fixes for the 1.4.1 update:

http://polyslash.com/2016/08/20/phantaruk-update-1-4-1/

[b]Sincerely,[/b]

[b]The Polyslash Team[/b]

notes.title: Phantaruk - The first 24 hours
notes.content:
[b]Hello Everybody,[/b]

Phantaruk launched without any problems last night and it's available with a 25% discount for the first week.

Some of the first reviews are in and Steam users have been playing the game since the launch. Thank you for all your comments and Steam reviews - we really appreciate it.

The Phantaruk Soundtrack by Draco Nared will be released separately as a DLC soon.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25706844/ad6fd40191af0352b875518b4e3d67e911a4ce49.jpg[/img]

Have a great night!

Sincerely,

The POLYSLASH Team

notes.title: Impressive Update 1.3.0 for Phantaruk
notes.content:
[b]Just two days left until the release![/b]

We are working hard to give you the best experience possible. Our game is more polished than ever but we want to make everything as good as possible and we are working day and night to get Phantaruk ready to meet you.

We don't want any clones hanging upside down from the ceiling, do we?

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25706844/ff1c88cb1a00b3f62bc4517fb1287e5e751790b2.png[/img]

Some of the most important changes are:

-improved performance (game runs in 60 FPS now)
-added Russian language version
-added completely new main menu
-updated achievements list
-added the ability to turn off the flashlight while using computers
-fixed controller issues
-balanced the number of batteries and syringes on every level

Please take a look at the full list of updates, changes and fixes for the 1.3.0 update:

http://polyslash.com/2016/08/14/phantaruk-update-1-3-0/

Add Phantaruk to your STEAM wishlist here: 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/468930/

[b]Sincerely,[/b] 

[b]The Polyslash Team[/b]

notes.title: Phantaruk Update 1.2.0
notes.content:
[b]Are you ready for more good news?[/b]

Another update is live and it brings a lot of tweaks and fixes plus some new features! We're approaching the release date and with only a week left, we are happy to share new information with you!

Some of the most important changes are:

-added Polish language version
-added new music
-added flashlight flickering effect
-added improved 3d models of various objects
-added overall sound balance
-fixed issues with monster not appearing correctly
-fixed issues with the resolution setting
-fixed audiolog issues

Full changelog for Update 1.2.0 available here:

http://polyslash.com/2016/08/08/phantaruk-update-1-2-0/

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25706844/9a1f71ed2057bc6af86fbec66f9f801ac4799a0c.png[/img]

[b]Sincerely,[/b]

[b]The Polyslash Team[/b]

notes.title: Phantaruk Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
[b]Hello![/b]

Update 1.1.0 is live and we are a step closer to the release of our game Phantaruk. We are working hard on fixing bugs and adding new features. We want Phantaruk to be ready to meet you on Purity-02 on August 16th. Thanks for all the help, we really appreciate all the feedback we’ve got from community and media.

Some of the most important changes are:

-added object: audiocube, animation and description
-added new clone behaviour
-added slow-motion effects when using computers, scraps, textlogs, etc.
-improved AI behaviour
-fixed checkpoints
-added new animations
-added new story notes
-added new audiologs

Full changelog for Update 1.1.0 available here:

http://polyslash.com/2016/07/29/phantaruk-update-1-1-0/

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25706844/22157fe6e8f741c0b05277ed2f924380da1692d9.png[/img]

Preview version of the game will receive this update tomorrow on 30th of July.

[b]Sincerely,[/b]

[b]The Polyslash Team[/b]

notes.title: Phantaruk arrives on August 16th
notes.content:
[b]Get ready to board the spaceship Purity-02 on August 16th![/b]

We are happy to announce that the game will be released on Steam on the 16th of August. This means you will get a chance to play Phantaruk this summer!

Get ready for some chills down your spine while sneaking through the corridors of this derelict spaceship... But is it really empty? What happened here? Why is your body attacked by strange toxins and where did the monster called Phantaruk come from?

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25706844/e43fe9c4395c3144a401b6ff3b7b5ca7c53c5ba8.png[/img]

You will learn all answers to your questions soon!

Check out the trailer on our YouTube channel: https://youtu.be/37CQd9tRHn0

[b]Cheers![/b]

[b]The Polyslash Team[/b]
